title: Pure Feral Imp
summary: Yugi Muto's Feral Imp Normal Monster and Rank 4 Xyz build, combining Feral Imp, Des Feral Imp, and his Duelist Kingdom Horn Equips with Rescue Rabbit, Unexpected Dai, and First of the Dragons. Normal Monster swarm cards put multiple copies of Feral Imp on the field at once for Rank 4 toolbox plays or Polymerization into an unaffected Fusion boss.

summary.title: Starters
points: Rescue Rabbit banishes itself from the field to Special Summon 2 copies of the Level 4 Normal Monster Feral Imp directly from your Deck.
Unexpected Dai Special Summons Feral Imp directly from the Deck while you control no monsters, preserving your Normal Summon.
Kagetokage Special Summons itself from the hand when you Normal Summon Feral Imp or Des Feral Imp, while Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousness Special Summons itself while you control Feral Imp.

summary.title: Opening: Rescue Rabbit (or Unexpected Dai + Extender)
steps: Normal Summon Rescue Rabbit and banish it to Special Summon 2 copies of Feral Imp from your Deck (or activate Unexpected Dai to summon Feral Imp, then Normal Summon another Level 4 with Kagetokage).
Take Route A (Rank 4 Control): Overlay the 2 Level 4 monsters into Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir, Tornado Dragon, or Daigusto Emeral.

Take Route B (First of the Dragons): Activate Polymerization to fuse 2 copies of Feral Imp into First of the Dragons, then use Daigusto Emeral or Dark Factory of Mass Production to recover the Feral Imps from the GY.

summary.title: Normal Monster Recursion & Lore Equips
summary.text: Because Feral Imp is a Level 4 DARK Fiend Normal Monster, Daigusto Emeral (Limited) can detach 1 material to Special Summon Feral Imp straight from the GY, Dark Factory of Mass Production adds 2 copies of Feral Imp from your GY back to your hand, and Link Spider converts Feral Imp into an Effect Monster for Link climbing into Wee Witch's Apprentice. Des Feral Imp provides a Flip recovery option that shuffles any card from your GY back into the Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: First of the Dragons (summoned by fusing 2 Normal Monsters) is completely unaffected by other monsters' effects and cannot be destroyed by battle except by another Normal Monster.

Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir locks the board into Defense Position and negates activated effects of Defense Position monsters, Tornado Dragon destroys Spells and Traps at Quick-Play speed, and Evilswarm Exciton Knight wipes the board when behind in total cards.
Wee Witch's Apprentice boosts all DARK monsters on the field (including Feral Imp, Des Feral Imp, and First of the Dragons) by 500 ATK/DEF and recovers a DARK monster from the GY when destroyed.

summary.title: Spells
points: Horn of the Unicorn (Yugi's anime Equip for Feral Imp) boosts the equipped monster by 700 ATK/DEF and returns to the top of the Deck when sent from the field to the GY, while Horn of Light adds 800 DEF.
Polymerization fuses 2 Feral Imps from your hand or field into First of the Dragons, and Dark Factory of Mass Production refills your hand with both Normal Monsters afterward.

allow.Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousne: Level 4 EARTH Beast that Special Summons itself while you control a Spellcaster or Normal Monster to make Rank 4 Xyz plays alongside Feral Imp.
allow.Polymerization: Fuses 2 copies of the Normal Monster Feral Imp together to summon First of the Dragons.
allow.Dark Factory of Mass Production: Adds 2 copies of the Normal Monster Feral Imp from your GY back to your hand to refuel your field.

allow.Daigusto Emeral: Rank 4 Xyz monster made with Level 4 monsters that detaches 1 material to Special Summon a Normal Monster (Feral Imp) from your GY, or shuffles 3 monsters from GY to draw 1 (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired T: Rank 4 Xyz monster that stalls the game by switching monsters to Defense Position and negating their activated effects.
allow.Tornado Dragon: Rank 4 Xyz monster that detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to destroy a Spell/Trap on the field.
allow.Evilswarm Exciton Knight: Rank 4 Xyz monster that destroys all other cards on the field if your opponent has more total cards.
allow.Wee Witch's Apprentice: Link-2 DARK monster that boosts all DARK monsters (including Feral Imp and Des Feral Imp) by 500 ATK/DEF.
allow.Link Spider: Link-1 monster summoned using the Normal Monster Feral Imp to convert it into an Effect Monster for Link plays.

main: Feral Imp
Yugi's iconic Level 4 DARK Fiend Normal Monster with 1300 ATK / 1400 DEF that serves as the primary Rescue Rabbit / Unexpected Dai target.
Des Feral Imp
Level 4 DARK Reptile Flip evolution of Feral Imp (1600 ATK / 1800 DEF) that shuffles 1 card from your GY back into the Deck when flipped face-up.
Rescue Rabbit
Banishes itself to summon 2 copies of Feral Imp directly from the Deck to Xyz Summon Rank 4 monsters or Link climb.
Unexpected Dai
Special Summons Feral Imp directly from the Deck while you control no monsters.
Kagetokage
Level 4 DARK Reptile that Special Summons itself from the hand whenever you Normal Summon a Level 4 monster (Feral Imp or Des Feral Imp).
Nefarious Archfiend Eater of Nefariousness
Level 4 EARTH Beast that Special Summons itself while you control a Normal Monster or Spellcaster to make Rank 4 Xyz plays.
Horn of the Unicorn
Yugi's signature Equip Spell for Feral Imp in Duelist Kingdom that increases ATK and DEF by 700 (putting Feral Imp at 2000 ATK / 2100 DEF) and returns to the top of the Deck when sent to the GY.
Horn of Light
Companion Horn Equip Spell that increases DEF by 800.
Polymerization
Fuses 2 copies of Feral Imp into First of the Dragons.
Dark Factory of Mass Production
Adds 2 Normal Monsters (Feral Imp) from your GY back to your hand.
extra: Fusion boss made with 2 Normal Monsters (Feral Imp) that is immune to monster effects and battle destruction by Effect Monsters.
Limited to 1 in TCG: Rank 4 Xyz that detaches 1 material to Special Summon Feral Imp from the GY or recycle 3 monsters to draw 1 card.
